PositiveBudget.description: Exact positive decimal USD amount no greater than 1000000.

PaperErrorCode.description: Stable allowlisted public failure code. Never contains provider text, credentials, account UUID, paths or exception messages.

PaperQuantity.description: Strictly positive exact decimal shares; at most nine fractional digits. Fractional DAY LIMIT additionally requires fresh certified asset capability.

PaperLimitPrice.description: Positive exact USD price; current asset tick policy is checked before planning.

symbols.description: JSON array with unique elements. Double negation preserves JSON Schema uniqueness while the pinned Angular generator retains the array wire type.

PaperControlRequest.description: Safety controls are independent of setup, credential, policy and provider readiness. PAUSE/KILL durably close the entry latch before acknowledgement. STOP also ends strategy planning; recovery continues. None liquidates holdings.

PaperLimitOrderRequest.description: Immutable human request; no direct broker submit. Uses the shared deterministic proposal, risk, reservation and execution path. SELL cannot exceed free long holdings. Server binds request ID and trace; no synthetic model decision. No notional, MARKET or fallback order.

PaperOperation.description: Persisted asynchronous command projection. ACCEPTED is durable receipt only, never trading approval or proof of broker success. CANCEL_ORDER may remain RUNNING while its order is CANCEL_PENDING; reservations remain until terminal reconciliation. Idempotent replay never creates a second obligation.

blockers.description: JSON array with unique elements. Double negation preserves JSON Schema uniqueness while the pinned Angular generator retains the array wire type.

PaperTradeProposal.description: Immutable paper proposal with truthful exclusive provenance. Human proposals reference the durable human request without inventing a model decision. Domain validation binds every execution value, generation, policy/budget version and trace to the source; TTL may only narrow.

PaperFeeAttestation.description: Explicit operator attestation for this direct-retail USD US-equity Paper fee scope only. It is bound atomically to the saved profile version; it does not assert a provider verification or activate trading.

PaperTradingProfile.description: Versioned isolated Paper settings. Unconfigured means no saved budget, strategy or fee attestation; policyVersion is zero only when no authoritative risk policy exists. Configured credential/account generations are the stored profile bindings and never silently rebind on rotation. Saving closes entry gates and never activates trading. strategyVersion names the stored strategy mapping, not a model run version.

PaperTradingProfileUpdateRequest.description: Create at expectedProfileVersion zero or update the exact existing version. Immutable actor/key/body replay is idempotent; conflicting reuse or stale bindings are refused. Explicit fee-scope confirmation is version bound. Save closes gates without activating a workflow or contacting providers.

PaperReadCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor bound to the alpaca-paper namespace, resource and account context. Never parse or persist provider identifiers. Malformed tokens return INVALID_REQUEST; changed context returns VERSION_CONFLICT.

PaperPosition.description: Stored position. costBasis is the exact matching ledger-version cost-basis evidence, or null; never quantity multiplied by the rounded average price.

PaperQuoteEvidence.description: Actual stored quote; timestamps are not renewed by GET. validUntil is the earlier of its stored proof validity and observedAt plus 30 seconds. Expired evidence remains visibly expired.

quote.description: Actual stored quote; timestamps are not renewed by GET. validUntil is the earlier of its stored proof validity and observedAt plus 30 seconds. Expired evidence remains visibly expired.

PaperSnapshot.description: Stored Paper projections only; GET performs no provider I/O. observedAt is query time, portfolio.asOf is financial-source time and status.reconciledAt is actual reconciliation time. No financial basis is represented by null portfolio and positions; an actual flat book has an empty positions array. Missing market proofs are null; stale proof timestamps remain unchanged.

PaperCancelOverlay.description: Independent durable cancellation obligation. FINISHED means the obligation is resolved; the actual order may be FILLED rather than CANCELED. Never replace the broker order status with this overlay.

cancel.description: Independent durable cancellation obligation. FINISHED means the obligation is resolved; the actual order may be FILLED rather than CANCELED. Never replace the broker order status with this overlay.

PaperOrder.description: Own stored order with exclusive genuine proposal provenance. Historical MARKET orders retain their actual type; DAY and REGULAR are emitted only with stored policy proof, otherwise null. No provider order/account identifier is exposed.

PaperFill.description: Local reconciled fill evidence reference, not a provider activity ID. fee is null unless an explicit per-fill fee proof exists; unknown fees are never represented by an invented zero.

PaperTrace.description: Explicit typed-source trace projection with at most 32 safe events. complete=false marks a bounded excerpt. Roles, semantic actions and canonical reason codes are mapped from reviewed sources; no raw audit actor/action/text, prompts, provider payloads or account/activity identifiers are forwarded. Unmapped reasons are omitted.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor bound to the alpaca-paper namespace, resource and account context. Never parse or persist provider identifiers. Malformed tokens return INVALID_REQUEST; changed context returns VERSION_CONFLICT.

PaperOperationPage.description: Reloadable original receipts. ACCEPTED and RUNNING operations precede terminal operations; each group is ordered by acceptedAt and operationId descending. The opaque keyset cursor includes this priority and account context. A recent terminal history must not hide unresolved work.
